notes.title: Changelog Demo v.1.4 - THE NPC UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Hi everyone! We have been made aware that our game's median play time is already very high [b](thank you guys!)[/b] and that it wouldn't be smart to add more content to the demo, so people will be more inclined to buy the full game at the release date. [/p][p][/p][p][b][i][u]But whoopsie, all this content dropped from our hands and right into the new update! 
[/u][/i][/b][i]How clumsy we are![/i][/p][p]
So, we added more stuff to make the demo more similar to the vision of what will be the actual final game. [b]This will be the last content update for the[/b] [b][u]DEMO[/u][/b]. 

There will be bug fixes, but content-wise, the demo will not receive additional content aside from bug fixing. So have fun![/p][h1][b]
MAJOR UPDATES:[/b][/h1][p]Now NPCs must be found before they offer their services to the hero:[/p][p][/p][h3]Added the Blacksmith to the demo's NPC roster[/h3][p]Go look for him! He might be important to your next run![/p][h3]
Find Eden![/h3][p]Yes, now Eden, our dear relic seller in the tavern, must be found around the dungeon.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Achievements[/h3][p]Who doesn't like new achievements?[/p][p][/p][h1]MAJOR FIXES:[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused monster cards to be destroyed by monsters’ sacrifice skills and abilities [i](yes, we're looking at you, turtle).[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Polished the game interface[/p][/*][*][p]Monster book looks improved.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]MINOR FIXES[/h1][list][*][p]Changed some monsters' effects to make it more balanced.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes all around the game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That's all for now! As always, thank you so much for your feedback and support.[/p][p]<3[/p][p][/p][p]Love, Atomic Hamster.[/p]

notes.title: Changelog Demo v.1.1 – THE CURSOR UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog Demo v.1.1 – THE CURSOR UPDATE[/h1][p]
Hey everyone![/p][p]We’ve just pushed a small update full of bug fixes, polish, and quality-of-life improvements for The Good Overlord demo. [/p][p]Let’s go over it:
[/p][h2]MAJOR FIXES
[/h2][h3]Fixes & Tweaks:[/h3][p]- We rotated the cursor, now it points like a normal pointer would. 
We heard you. 
It happened. 
[i]It was painful.[/i]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/65d261fb57df083c671a733c10aa375426379a9f.gif"][/img][/p][p]- Lava tiles now react more clearly when the hero steps on them.[/p][p]- Crossbows trajectory now don't make the game lag[/p][p]- Hero pathfinding has been improved to prevent him from getting stuck.[/p][p]- Several monster ability descriptions have been clarified.
[/p][h3]Boss Fight:[/h3][p]- [b]Carmelo[/b] – Turns out the hero was very committed to grabbing coins, even mid-boss phasing. We fixed that.[/p][p]- [b]MKUltra[/b] – Healing turrets no longer spawn on top of each other.
[/p][h2]MINOR FIXES & POLISH[/h2][p]- More sound effects have been added across the board.[/p][p]- Eden’s relic selection now gives clearer feedback when you select your relic.[/p][p]- Shadow fixes on Eden's shop, now it doesn't cover the bottom UI.[/p][p]- Keywords now appear even inside the bag when checking a monster data card[/p][p]- Some balance tweaks here and there.[/p][p]- New interactables have been added to the Overlord's office. Go poke around.[/p][p]- All UI buttons now jiggle while they're hovered over. Yes, it was important.[/p]

notes.title: VERSION 1.0 OF THE DEMO IS NOW LIVE ON STEAM!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/ee83907e33c290a6d449736b099fb62157bfb51a.gif[/img]

[i]Long time no see!
[/i]And that’s why it's time for a, drumroll, devlog!
First of all, version 1.0 of the demo will come out publicly (and hopefully without crucial bugs) on the 2nd of July during the #turnbasedthursday festival on Steam.
In this article, we will talk about all the new cool features, what is coming, and what we're working to fix!

[b]Let’s start with the juice:
[/b]
[h2]1) NEW FEATURES[/h2]
[h3]THE SACRIFICE ROOM[/h3]
The new addition to the game! Each monster (yes, all 300+ of them) has a special ability that will activate itself automatically during fights.
You should really play the demo and check out ALL of them. Some of them will give you cool accessories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/78a23f33cb26da8d3ca3b90ada8b87f77603afb2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/301c859e3382cffed18e7edf6387ef2965ac795b.gif[/img]

[h3]JESTER WHEEL[/h3]
Tired of not having enough RNG? No? Well, we were! So we added a room where you play the jester's game of "who will die next." Spin the wheel if you're brave enough, and maybe, just maybe, you'll get a cool bonus. Or you might sign up for your hero's death.
It is what it is.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/20aaee825974f8684efa101e23a22232871a470b.gif[/img]

[h3]NEW HUD![/h3]
The HUD is constantly improving. We kept the same one for a long time due to lack of production time, but now, after hearing your feedback, we hope it'll be a bit more understandable.
The HP bar has a signal to show where the 50% mark is, so it's easier to understand when EMERGENCY abilities will pop up. There’s also a clearer way to check on XP and stats like DMG and COINS.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/878584c822ccab561d8d849b1b77767e5b9be840.gif[/img]

[h3]ILLUMINATION[/h3]
So, we haven't yet touched a lot of the illumination in the game. That's because we're giving priority to feedback and the mechanics themselves before really polishing everything up, but it'd be a shame not to show off our lighting system to y'all—so slowly but surely, we're adding lights everywhere!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/7f5b8d3fbbad08c74996b6f8d5a567bb2572f51d.gif[/img]

[h2]2) WHAT’S TO COME[/h2]
[h3]BLACKSMITH LIAR[/h3]
We can't really say much about this one, but it would be a shame if the hero only wielded the same sword for the whole game, right? So, at the start of the run, if you find the right guy in the dungeon, he’ll... gift you the right sword to wield for the run.
Each sword has its own perks and abilities!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/60359b66d5cfd7ade1c644c4dd5aff9b23fd3125.gif[/img]

[h3]NEW EDEN UI[/h3]
Our dear Eden's shop right now is just hidden beneath his coat. Yes, exactly like the dude who tries to sell sundials to another guy in a specific movie. Can’t really remember who the guy is though, huh.
But he's working on making the tavern a little bit more like his home. He's not there yet, but he's trying very hard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/110312649d12ccf5369f5b4d8c5c73ddede9ba7c.png[/img]

[h3]
LISANDRA SHOP[/h3]
So, it would be kind of weird if a bartender only sold you ONE specific drink, so we decided that you can pick between 3+ more drinks with different effects.
Yeah, tons of choices.

We know.

[h2]3) BUG FIX[/h2]

We know there still might be some minor fixes and issues, and we always appreciate you giving us feedback!
We did work on most of the more annoying bugs, but as you all know, they are sneaky and hard to find. So If you guys find something, please do contact us through the button "Report a Bug" in the OPTIONS MENU!

That’s all for now.
We’re incredibly excited for you to dive into the updated demo during the #TurnBasedThursday event starting TODAY!

Until then, stay lucky, and have a good run in the dungeon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/e6ec25783132f1acb197790253edffac87dacd35.png[/img]

notes.title: Tons of Updates and a Demo Coming Soon?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/ee83907e33c290a6d449736b099fb62157bfb51a.gif[/img]
[b]We reached 1000 + wishlists!
[/b]
Most of the work this months were programming related, so let's get to it!

[h2][b]Big updates first:[/b]
[/h2]
[h3]MONSTER RARITY:
[/h3]
As we mentioned in previous versions, monsters were drawn randomly from the pool you selected at the HUB. Now, we’ve spiced things up. You might draw Rare and Legendary monsters from a special in-game pool.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/e161524297d3ce1534210ac844aabc7815187dac.gif[/img]
They won't appear in monster books—they will pop up randomly if you’re lucky enough!

[h3]BOSS FIGHTS:
[/h3]
A huge thing that we Always wanted to change about the boss fights were how they worked, was pretty hard to understand how to make them more entertaining, but we think we reached a goal:
We’ve completely revamped how boss fights work. Now, bosses enter a second phase when their HP drops to half.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/a2b9fd0d61e053697747351872cb64872f444108.gif[/img]
[i]You’ll need to adapt to room changes to survive. It could either ruin or save you,
[/i]Good luck!

[h3]IMPROVED UI:
[/h3]
We took our old UI of the data window and threw it away, i mean, not litterally, we just changed some stuff.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/05be29313db90270750b46693c9ff6f9960dddb1.gif[/img]
Now everything has a TAG to help you understand it better. Monsters TAGs are color-coded, and you can view buffs and debuffs number directly on the window.

[h3]LOADS OF BUGFIXING AND BALACING:
[/h3]
Before adding more content, we focused on fixing bugs and balancing the game to avoid a future pile-up (programmers ou there, we know you are proud of us). We fixed all major crashes, improved hero pathfinding, fixed collisions, and covered most possible combinations bugs so far.

[h3]MAGIC? NAH THATS TOO OLD SCHOOL
[/h3]
We’ve decided to remove the magic room for now. The feedback was clear, and honestly, it didn’t fit well. We’ve replaced it with something else (might involve sacrifices… but who knows?).

[h3]MONSTER CHOICE UI UPGRADE:
[/h3]
Tired of the old drawer system? No worries! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/c58d31d8b1bd3370b5779f491874e3d2cb855e2a.gif[/img]
Now, after each combat room, the monster book will slam onto your UI, giving you a choice between 3 random monsters!

[h2][b]SMALLER UPDATES:[/b]
[/h2]
[h3]Polish, polish, polish
[/h3]
You know by now how much Daniel and I love polishing the game. Some might say it’s a waste of time, but we enjoy adding small details.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/74e819a5c0fbdc6bb80d83052dc0da5ed1f21441.gif[/img]
Now, if you click on lava, it splashes.
We did lots of stuff like that.
We got you.

[h3]Story???
[/h3]
And now you’re probably thinking: "What? The game has a story?"
Yes, it actually has pages upon pages of lore that we've been working on throughout the year, which we finally finished.
While Daniel was busy bug-fixing everything, I started working on the art related to the lore that we completed last month with Iolanda, our narrative designer.
Unfortunately, we can't share anything about it just yet ( :( ), but we are so hyped to show you guys.

We honestly can’t wait to release the full game and hear your thoughts.

[h3](WIP) NPC unlocking[/h3]
We’ve added the first quest to unlock Ravenshadow! We won’t spoil anything, you’ll have to see for yourself.

[h3](WIP) New relics, new monsters.[/h3]
We’ve added a bit of new content while working on everything else. Not too much for now—we want to ensure the foundation is solid before adding more layers.

[h2][b]AND NOW?[/b][/h2]
We’re finalists in two competitions: [b]Redbull Indie Forge and the GWB Game Awards by Tencent[/b]. This won’t impact development since we're always working on the game, but it will add to our workload as we handle all the social media and related tasks.
[b]Light a candle for us.
[/b]
Also, some big news are coming, maybe of a... [b][u][i]playable demo?[/i][/u][/b]
We'll keep you updated on that, but it might be coming sooner than you think.

notes.title: The Good Overlord v0.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/ee83907e33c290a6d449736b099fb62157bfb51a.gif[/img]
We're excited to bring you the latest updates on The Good Overlord. Here's how our roadmap looks right now until the next deadline:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/f96f4f6621597ea3b01a1f1deeb3445540e6ec3a.png[/img]

Weird writing? idk what you talking about

[h2]Intro WIP[/h2]

The introduction of the game is currently in progress, and we can't wait to share it with you! Stay tuned for more updates on this.

[h2]Debugging Playtest of the Hub[/h2]

We are meticulously debugging the issues our playtesters have found. Our goal is to deliver a polished demo, targeted for release sometime in 2025. As a two-person team, this process takes considerable time and effort. We're working full-time, day and night, to ensure The Good Overlord runs smoothly. Daniel is diligently fixing every nook and cranny of this game.

[h2]Monsters Go Boom[/h2]

Monsters now explode when they die! While we couldn't go full DOOM-style, we're working on making safe-for-work explosions for both humans and beasts. Stay tuned for more explosive fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/323c7395f8afc97c871f67e2930d68d970f3fa41.gif[/img]

[h2]Save System for Monsters and Traps[/h2]

Yes, you can now save the game! While you can't save during a run, you can save the amount of GEMS you collect, the monsters and traps you unlock, and the ones you bring along. We're working hard to make this system as stress-free as possible.

[h2]All NPCs Finalized[/h2]

All NPCs have their final design! Finally! Here's a sneak peek at some of them. And yes, they are all 100% human. Why do you ask?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/efed317e772cd64adca56aabf6187c10c12a6437.png[/img]

[h2]Accessibility Options[/h2]

We're constantly improving our accessibility options. As a dyslexic developer, my eyes go BLEEEH every time there's too many tnts or magic orbs in the room, the areas overlap themselves and it's hard to focus on the strategy. That's why Daniel had the brilliant idea to give the option to increase the pixel size of the circle of the range for better readability when there are too many ranges on the screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/662984ddc7f250d49d28aaf57843a1d6ae9067ca.gif[/img]

[h2]NEW EFFECT JOINS THE FIGHT![/h2]

Introducing "Transform": When a monster is played with another monster that is affiliated with it, they will transform. Get ready for some exciting new combinations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/da6ca7589bbe42ae42af40f8084df330d75b5175.gif[/img]

We hope you're as excited as we are about these updates. We're dedicated to making The Good Overlord the best experience it can be, and we appreciate your patience and support.

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for being part of this journey with us.
[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/good-overlord-v0-105935303]If you noticed something weird about this post, maybe you should check it out on our Patreon.[/url]

As always, have a great week <3

The Atomic Hamster Team
